It has been approximately 5 years since me and my family were stopped in a parking lot in Midvale, about 9 PM. About 10 police officers attempted a pathetic staging and show of force. Hiding behind their vehicle, guns drawn. Barking orders to me to exit a minivan and follow their silly protocols. After all of the officers could see that I had no weapons hiding in my t-shirt and shorts. The guns were still sighted on me. The reason for this useless exercise. I was entering my office with a key and a drunk neighbor called the police, certain I was bent on stealing office supplies. There is a hot market for an old printer and paper clips. After explaining this to the one officer. He let it slip that this drunk person gives “bad tips” routinely. Somehow this was never communicated. 
About 18 months ago. In the same minivan. We were at a gas station and I was venting emotion while filling up. Apparently a do-gooder called the police in Lehi and created an outlandish story about me terrorizing the entire area and destroying property (I may have spilled some water from the reservoir that holds the windshield cleaning fluid supply). All geared up and ready to go, the police stopped us about 4 blocks West at a different gas station. I was sitting in the middle row and officers approached. Me, simply asking what the stop was for led to them thrusting open the door and ripping me from the van. 4 officers carrying me towards and slamming my ribs into the front of a police SUV. Fully subdued, claiming I was resisting while cuffed. About 40 people stood by and watched this entirely unnecessary assault on me. After an hour of questioning and useless police nonsense, we were allowed to leave. 

This is what happens in Utah.
